gitPublication.deploymentRisk: GitHub exposes seven historical vercel[bot] deployments named Production, including current HEAD. The API also reports production_environment:false, which does not establish a push is deployment-free. Vercel official documentation says every branch push can deploy. A new branch alone is not a safe no-deploy guarantee.
gitPublication.documentedControl: git.deploymentEnabled in a reviewed vercel.json can disable all or selected branch deployments. No such file exists currently; do not modify deployment settings or push without resolving the explicit no-deployment constraint.
